comment: Pilot delta limits for the native klt pex run (issue #335), declared BEFORE any result is recorded. Do not edit after results are seen: a change needs a separate dated commit with reasoning, before the next run. These deltas never replace the ratified absolute limits on vref_* (graded independently from the manifest).
origin: Curator revision on issue #335 (2026-11-06); values were chosen without a prior run and are carried over unchanged.
bench: sim/output-voltage-tc/experiment.json (spec rows 1a/1b), 5 process x 3 supply = 15 corners, temperature swept inside the deck
comparison: extracted minus schematic, per corner, on the injector-inclusive composed cell

observables.name: vref_27
observables.rationale: About 28 % of the 17.6 mV margin the 1b record shows to the ratified lower bound at tt/27C; layout parasitics should not consume most of the margin.

observables.name: vref_min
observables.rationale: Sweep extreme across -40..125 C; same order as the 5-10 mV spread between 1b corners.

observables.rationale: Sweep extreme across -40..125 C; same order as the 5-10 mV spread between 1b corners.
